settings.title: International Address Settings
settings.description: Configure the country list and the autocomplete provider of the overseas address window.
settings.notice: The country-aware form and validation work without autocomplete. Autocomplete API keys are used in the browser, so always restrict them to your site domain in the provider console.

guide.title: How it works
guide.step1: An "Overseas address" button appears next to the Korean postcode button on every screen with an address search slot (checkout, shipping addresses, profile, ...).
guide.step2: On ecommerce screens the chosen address fills the international fields (lines 1-2, city, state, postal code) and the shipping country, and shipping is recalculated.
guide.step3: Screens without international fields (profile, ...) receive the postal code and a single-line address.
guide.step4: To enable autocomplete, choose a provider and enter its API key. With no key, only manual entry is available.

provider.label: Autocomplete provider
provider.hint: Service used for address autocomplete. With "None", only the country-aware form and validation are used.

google_api_key.label: Google Places API key
google_api_key.hint: Key with Places API (New) enabled. Restrict HTTP referrers to your site domain.

loqate_api_key.label: Loqate API key
loqate_api_key.hint: Loqate (Address Capture) key. Restrict allowed domains in your account.

geoapify_api_key.label: Geoapify API key
geoapify_api_key.hint: Geoapify key. Has a free tier; restrict allowed origins.

default_country.label: Default country
default_country.hint: Country selected when the window opens (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. US)

allowed_countries.label: Allowed countries
allowed_countries.hint: Comma-separated country codes (e.g. US,JP,CN). Empty means all. Ecommerce shipping screens show only countries also enabled for shipping.

exclude_kr.label: Exclude South Korea
exclude_kr.hint: Removes South Korea from the list so domestic addresses go through the Korean postcode search.

theme_color.label: Theme color
theme_color.hint: Accent color of the address window. (e.g. #1D4ED8)

plugin_read_only: You do not have permission to change this plugin's settings, so they are shown read-only.
